reason: Seven masks including four carved Indonesian masks and a Terminator style skull replica; a mid range group but with no marks or signs of older ritual masks.
findings: Seven masks. Four carved and painted wooden Indonesian masks: a dog or cat like dance mask with animal hair eyebrows and red mouth, a grey ape or monkey mask with fur brows, a Javanese style female topeng with black hair and gold forehead ornament, and a plain cream Javanese female mask with batik style headdress. Also a carved white panda mask with glass eyes (tourist style), a painted Chinese opera style face mask with a black velvet strap, and a chrome finish Terminator T-800 endoskeleton style skull mask with red eyes and red cord lacing (probably a modern replica or costume piece; maker not visible). No maker's marks, signatures or labels visible. The wooden masks look like Balinese or Javanese dance or tourist masks; age and quality cannot be judged from one photo.
condition: Panda and Javanese masks show surface dirt and paint wear; the dog mask hair looks worn. No cracks seen.
rescore_note: Seven masks: four hand-carved Javanese or Balinese style wooden masks (tourist to mid-century grade, no marks), a panda, a Chinese opera face and a chrome Terminator skull replica; decorative and sellable but no sign of older ritual pieces, so $80 to 200 band. (no web price check)
